title: Oven Roasted Indian Sirloin Steak Tips Rajma
description: A tangy and flavorful Indian dish featuring sirloin steak tips, served in a rajma style with a bouncy texture, perfect for a special occasion, and diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sirloin steak tips to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the steak tips to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the steak tips are cooked to desired level of doneness.
While the steak tips are cooking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the saucepan and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato to the saucepan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the kidney beans, lemon juice, and cooked steak tips, and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until heated through.
